subject.title: [Feature]: Session busy status reply + cancel option during long-running model responses

question: Should OpenClaw add a default or configurable core busy acknowledgement for same-session active-run contention, and what portable text/actions/reason metadata should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding user-visible replies and possible config/default behavior changes affects every channel and must compose with existing /queue, /stop, /new, steering, and followup semantics.

options.title: Define core busy contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the generic busy reply, default/config behavior, action guidance, and stable reason metadata before implementation.

options.title: Fold into an adjacent queue PR
options.body: Require an active queue-admission or delivery-fencing PR to explicitly implement and prove the busy acknowledgement contract, not only serialization or delivery ordering.

options.title: Rely on current queue controls
options.body: Leave /queue, /stop, /new, typing, and docs as the supported workaround, accepting that no immediate busy explanation is sent during active-run contention.

recommendation.title: Define core busy contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the generic busy reply, default/config behavior, action guidance, and stable reason metadata before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest queue-policy history and already reviewed this issue as the canonical busy-session UX request.
